description: This file defines the CatalogItemService class, which implements ICatalogItemService to manage catalog items via HTTP requests. It provides methods for creating, editing, deleting, retrieving, and listing catalog items, often combining data from lookup services and the HTTP API.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Implements catalog item management by providing CRUD operations and list retrieval with lookup data integration, following dependency injection pattern.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via HTTP POST request.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, enriching it with brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Fetches a paged list of catalog items with associated brand and type names, with logging.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Fetches all catalog items with associated brand and type names, with logging.
